blocks.orig: Cancelled or delayed flight? Car trouble during your safari? With our Hakuna Matata Package we make sure that nothing disrupts your holiday and that you can enjoy a worry-free African travel experience – free of charge. Let’s have a look at this exclusive Your Tanzania Trip offer.
blocks.html: Flight delayed or cancelled? Vehicle trouble in the middle of your safari? Our Hakuna Matata Package ensures that nothing gets in the way of your holiday, so you can enjoy a worry-free African travel experience – at no extra cost. Here is a closer look at this exclusive Your Tanzania Trip offer.

blocks.orig: The Hakuna Matata Package is Your Tanzania Trip’s complimentary support package, included with every tailor-made holiday. The included services provide assistance before and during your trip, including flexible payment options, support when unexpected situations affect your safari, and help adjusting your itinerary when necessary. Optional services such as travel insurance, VIP airport pickup, and a local SIM or eSIM are available at an additional cost.
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip’s Hakuna Matata Package is a complimentary support package that comes with every tailor-made holiday. The services it covers help you before and during your trip: flexible payment options, support when something unexpected affects your safari, and assistance with changing your itinerary where needed. Extras such as travel insurance, VIP airport pickup and a local SIM or eSIM can be added for an additional fee.

blocks.orig: A holiday begins way before you step out of the plane, and we want to make sure that you know what to expect.
blocks.html: Your holiday starts long before you step off the plane, and we want you to know exactly what lies ahead.

blocks.orig: Before your safari, you receive a detailed travel dossier with practical information about your route, accommodations, and activities. We also arrange airport pickup, and if your departure is more than 120 days away, you only need to pay 25% when booking. Of course, life happens, so if you need to cancel or postpone your trip, our clear and fair cancellation and refund policies explain your options. You can find them in our terms and conditions under point 5.3.
blocks.html: Ahead of your safari, we send you a detailed travel dossier with practical details about your route, accommodation and activities. Airport pickup is arranged too, and when your departure is more than 120 days away, a 25% deposit is all you pay at booking. Life does not always go to plan, so should you need to cancel or postpone, our clear and fair cancellation and refund policies set out your options. They are listed in our terms and conditions under point 5.3.

blocks.orig: Book your flight through us, and it becomes part of your Hakuna Matata Package.
blocks.html: If you book your flight with us, it is covered by your Hakuna Matata Package.

blocks.html: What help can you count on during your Tanzania safari?

blocks.orig: When you’re out and about exploring the Tanzanian wonders, you might think, “What can go wrong?” With us, nothing. Even if it does.
blocks.html: While you are out discovering the wonders of Tanzania, you may wonder, “What could possibly go wrong?” With us, nothing. And if something does, we handle it.

blocks.orig: During your safari, you travel in a well-maintained 4×4 vehicle with support from local bush garages and replacement vehicles if needed. Your professionally trained private guide stays with you throughout the journey, and our team is available 24/7 to assist with unexpected situations.
blocks.html: On safari you ride in a well-maintained 4×4, backed by local bush garages and replacement vehicles should they be needed. Your professionally trained private guide accompanies you for the whole journey, and our team can be reached 24/7 if something unexpected comes up.

blocks.orig: We work with many partners who have the same goal as us: make your holiday as worry-free as possible. Therefore, you can extend your Hakuna Matata Package with some exclusive add-ons. These are not included in your package and need to be paid separately (but they’re worth every penny).
blocks.html: We collaborate with many partners who share our aim of making your holiday as carefree as possible. That is why your Hakuna Matata Package can be extended with a few exclusive add-ons. These fall outside the package and are paid for separately (but they’re worth every penny).

blocks.orig: Because Your Tanzania Trip has a local team and trusted partners in Tanzania, we can respond quickly when something unexpected affects your trip. Depending on the situation, we may contact your guide, accommodation, airline, or transport partner and help adjust the remaining itinerary.
blocks.html: With a local team and trusted partners on the ground in Tanzania, Your Tanzania Trip can act fast when the unexpected affects your trip. Depending on what has happened, we may get in touch with your guide, accommodation, airline or transport partner and help rework the rest of your itinerary.

blocks.orig: Frequently asked questions about the Hakuna Matata Package
blocks.html: Common questions about the Hakuna Matata Package

blocks.orig: The Hakuna Matata Package is Your Tanzania Trip’s support package, designed to give you extra peace of mind before and during your safari. It includes practical travel information, flexible payment options, and support if unexpected situations affect your trip.
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip’s Hakuna Matata Package is a support package meant to give you added peace of mind before and during your safari. It brings together practical travel information, flexible ways to pay and help whenever something unexpected affects your trip.

blocks.orig: Yes, the standard Hakuna Matata Package is included when you book your safari with Your Tanzania Trip. Some additional services, such as travel insurance, VIP airport pickup, and a local SIM or eSIM, are available at an extra cost.
blocks.html: Yes: book your safari with Your Tanzania Trip and the standard Hakuna Matata Package is automatically part of it. A few extras, among them travel insurance, VIP airport pickup and a local SIM or eSIM, can be added for an additional fee.

blocks.orig: During your safari, you travel with a professionally trained private guide and have access to 24/7 support. Our local team and trusted partners can assist if unexpected circumstances affect your vehicle, accommodation, transport, or itinerary.
blocks.html: Throughout your safari you are accompanied by a professionally trained private guide, and help is available around the clock. Should something unexpected happen to your vehicle, accommodation, transport or itinerary, our local team and trusted partners step in.

blocks.orig: Our safari vehicles are carefully maintained, but technical problems can still occur. If needed, we can arrange support through local bush garages or provide a replacement vehicle so that your safari can continue with as little disruption as possible.
blocks.html: We maintain our safari vehicles with care, but technical issues can never be ruled out entirely. Where necessary, we arrange help via local bush garages or supply a replacement vehicle, so your safari carries on with minimal disruption.

blocks.orig: When you book your international flight through Your Tanzania Trip, we help arrange a suitable alternative if it is significantly delayed or cancelled. We can also assist with necessary accommodation, itinerary adjustments, and communication with the airline, depending on the circumstances and applicable conditions.
blocks.html: Has the international flight you booked via Your Tanzania Trip been cancelled or seriously delayed? Then we help find a suitable alternative. Depending on the situation and the conditions that apply, we can also help with any accommodation required, changes to your itinerary and liaising with the airline.

blocks.orig: You can add services such as VIP airport pickup, assistance with a local SIM or eSIM, travel insurance, and a Farewell Experience before your return flight. These services are arranged separately and at an additional cost and are not included in the standard Hakuna Matata Package.
blocks.html: Services you can add include VIP airport pickup, help with a local SIM or eSIM, travel insurance and a Farewell Experience before you fly home. These are arranged separately at an additional cost and do not form part of the standard Hakuna Matata Package.
